name: voice-gate
description: A single-voice writing instrument in three skills. voice-gate checks a finished nonfiction piece against a supplied voice profile and renders one locked scorecard and one verdict; diagnose-only, it never edits. voice-gate-builder generates that profile from a writer's corpus; voice-gate-interview builds the same profile by a consent-first interview when no corpus exists, grounding any pasted samples. Both prove it through a human-graded calibration gate they never self-grade.
